abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Nova Repeater/Plasma Claws
abilities.description: Ranged: Basic attack that fires 8 rounds per second, each dealing (+11% physical power) physical damage. Melee: Basic attack chain with 4 light attacks that deals (+35% physical power) physical damage, followed by a heavy attack that deals (+100% physical power).

abilities.name: Helios Core
abilities.description: Eden generates Heat from dealing damage to Heroes. Upon reaching 300 Heat, Eden Overheats, gaining access to her Limit Break abilities. Heat will decay when not dealing damage to Heroes for 3.5s. Heat Generation is increased by 12.5%/30%/47.5%/65% based on Ultimate Level. Eden converts 1% Attack Speed into 60% increased Physical Power.

abilities.name: Tachyon Lance/Axiom Strike
abilities.description: Ranged: Fire a piercing laser, dealing 70.0/95.0/120.0/145.0/170.0 (+70.0/75.0/80.0/85.0/90.0% physical power)(+100% physical penetration) physical damage, dealing 50% damage to Targets beyond the first. Melee: Using her twin claws, Eden spins rapidly 4 times, each time dealing 15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0/35.0 (+15% physical power)(+95% physical penetration) physical damage, before unleashing a lightning strike forward, dealing 60.0/80.0/100.0/120.0/140.0 (+45% physical power) (+280% physical penetration) physical damage and slowing Targets hit by 50% for 0.75s.

abilities.name: Zero Shift
abilities.description: Eden switches between ranged and melee stances, changing her abilities and basic attack. Ranged Stance Passive: Eden gains 6.0/14.0/22.0/30.0/38.0 Physical Power. Melee Stance Passive: Eden restores Health equal to 6.0/10.0/14.0/18.0/22.0% of damage dealt to Heroes.

abilities.name: Sidewind/Talon Drive
abilities.description: Ranged: Thrust in current movement direction and empower your Nova Repeater for 1.5s to launch an empowered Railshot that explodes dealing 70.0/100.0/130.0/160.0/190.0 (+70% physical power) (+85% physical penetration) physical damage to Targets hit. Melee: Dash towards Target enemy, uppercutting them, dealing 80.0/105.0/130.0/155.0/180.0 (+90% physical power) physical damage and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s.

abilities.name: Limit Break
abilities.description: Ranged: Eden channels for a brief duration before flying upwards to fire four concentrated beams of energy that decimate Targets over 1s, each dealing 50.0/100.0/150.0/200.0 (+65% physical power) physical damage and applying a 40% Slow for 1.5s. Eden will then rapidly descend back to the location she flew from. Melee: Eden channels for a brief duration, before teleporting to the Target location, striking Targets within over 2.4s. Each strike deals 30.0/42.0/54.0/66.0 (+27% physical power) physical damage, decreased by 10% per consecutive hit, up to 80%, and Slowing targets hit by 15% for 0.5s. Eden can move the target location whilst striking. After the duration, Eden slams into the ground from above, dealing 100.0/195.0/290.0/385.0 (+150% physical power) physical damage.

augments.name: Kinetic Waltz
augments.description: Axiom Strike deals 90% damage, has 30% reduced cooldown and grants 35% movement speed for 1.5s when damaging Enemy Heroes.

augments.name: Focal Lens
augments.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Tachyon Lance shreds their Physical Armor by 25% for 4s and reduces the cooldown by 10%.

augments.name: Limit Break: Echo
augments.description: After casting Limit Break, the cooldowns of your basic abilities in your current stance are instantly refreshed.
